mainEntity.name: What is a Cloud Security Assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Cloud Security Assessment evaluates your cloud infrastructure for vulnerabilities, compliance gaps, and risks, ensuring secure operations and protection of sensitive data.
Our assessment covers IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS platforms across public, private, and hybrid cloud environments.
We align cloud infrastructure with ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, and local regulatory requirements, ensuring your systems meet industry best practices.

mainEntity.name: What types of security tests are performed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tests include internal/external network penetration testing, application security assessments, endpoint security testing, firewall and VPN reviews, and configuration analysis.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Cloud Security Assessment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Depending on the size and complexity of your cloud infrastructure, assessments typically take between 2 to 6 weeks.

mainEntity.name: Will my data be safe during assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. All assessments are conducted under strict confidentiality agreements, ensuring your data and systems remain secure.
Yes. After identifying gaps and vulnerabilities, we provide actionable remediation recommendations and support to fix the issues.

mainEntity.name: How do you handle multi-cloud environments?

acceptedAnswer.text: We assess each cloud platform independently while also reviewing integrations and data flow between different cloud providers.

mainEntity.name: Can this assessment be used for regulatory audits?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The assessment report is structured to assist in regulatory audits and compliance verification.

mainEntity.name: Why choose ISECURION for Cloud Security Assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: ISECURION is a CERT-IN empanelled, ISO 27001 certified company with expert consultants providing comprehensive, end-to-end cloud security assessments and actionable remediation guidance.
